Remaining tasks until --verifytypes passes and `check_type_completeness.py` can be removed
To get a bit of an overview of the remaining files until we hit Type Completeness :tm:

## Public API
* TypeVarTuple support - needs to be checked with pyright instead of mypy that they're correct, but mypy should be able to accept their presence.
  * not really possible to get mypy to accept their presence in my testing, we need to wait for mypy 1.7. Tracked in #2859
* [x] SocketType, see #2720 - @jakkdl 
* _core/
  * [x] _mock_clock #2740
  * [x] _run #2733 
    * [x] _generated_run #2733
  * [x] _io_epoll #2743
    * [x] _generated_io_epoll #2743
  * [x] _io_kqueue #2743
    * [x] _generated_io_kqueue #2743
  * [x] _io_windows - some work in #2763, but I would like somebody else to take over and finish.
    * [x] _generated_io_windows
  * [x] _thread_cache #2741
  * [x] _traps #2763
* [x] testing/ #2747
* _highlevel
  * [x] _socket
  * [x] _ssl_helpers
  * [x] _serve_listeners
  * [x] _open_tcp_listeners #2724
  * [x] _open_unix_stream
* [x] _ssl #2745
* [x] _subprocess
* [x] _threads
* [x] _signals #2794 (`_open_signal_receiver` is clearly exported in `trio/__init__.py`, but for some reason doesn't show up in the file list when I run `--verifytypes`)

~~Possibly more files if running with a --pythonplatform other than linux.~~

## Private or deprecated (lower priority)
May include files that should be in the above list, I didn't look through files in a fully complete way
* _core/
  * [x] _asyncgens #2735 
  * [x] _multierror #2742
  * [x] _io_common #2763
  * [x] _windows_cffi #2755
  * [x] _ki #2763 
  * [x] _wakeup_socketpair #2763
* _tools/
  * [x] _gen_exports.py #2738
* [x] _windows_pipes #2812
* [x] _wait_for_object (windows) #2755 
* testing/
  * [x] _fake_net #2763 (This file should maybe be moved to _tests/ as it's only used internally)
* [x] _subprocess_platform/waitid
* [x] various files 

## Tests
Typing the tests will check that it's possible to use the interface in a reasonable way, as well as catch any possible bugs in the tests themself of course.
* [x] trio/testing/_fake_net
* [x] trio/_core/_tests/
* [x] trio/_tests/

## docstrings
* [x] #2762 

## Cleanup
* #2877
  * [x] Remove references to `py.typed` in the code, from when we needed to generate it on-the-fly because it wasn't statically added in the package.
  * [x] Remove `check_type_completeness.py`, `verify_types_[windows,linux,darwin].json` and their entries in `check.sh`
  * [x] Add `pyright --verifytypes` with multiple platforms to `check.sh`, and/or pre-commit.
Move to src-layout.
The intention of this is better isolation. `trio` is no longer accidentally on the (python) path and as such requires an explicit installation for usage, this helps uncover issues in packaging data etc early on (see
https://packaging.python.org/en/latest/discussions/src-layout-vs-flat-layout/).

This serves as the basis for switching to another build system as well; refs #2790.
